notes.title: Updated Demo + Kickstarter
notes.content:
Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery's updated demo is now available to everyone! We've completely overhauled the look of Lock & Key, featuring brand new character artwork by milkgrrl, an updated UI, and more. It was previously released for Patrons on our Demo Access tier, which gives Patrons early access to demo & beta builds for some of our games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/690c03a835684a499d7ec7e1a0103e5eb1e2f91b.jpg

This new demo comes out to mark the beginning of our Kickstarter campaign! We have physical game copies, an artbook, keychains, and more up for preorder as part of the campaign.

[previewyoutube=rwmYHRWiubU;full][/previewyoutube]

We also have a few stretch goals to improve the game we'd like to hit - and with your support, we can!

Thank you everyone for your support. If you want more frequent updates on Lock & Key, we're doing monthly update posts on our Patreon.

notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival
notes.content:
The Storyteller's Festival is happening now! This is a week-long Steam festival focused on visual novels and other story-driven games. There's over 400 games in the event—including a few of ours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/09d22910cf3313ce627bed309a47fe8a247723a6.png

Here's a few of our other LGBT+ yuri titles that are in the festival—give them a wishlist or check out their demos if you'd like to support us!

A Tithe in Blood is a dark yuri romance story about modern magic mixing with old mysteries.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989270/A_Tithe_in_Blood/

Summer at the Edge of the Universe is an LGBT+ yuri solarpunk adventure about the trip of a lifetime through the cosmos.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641720/Summer_at_the_Edge_of_the_Universe/

Our Home, My Keeper is a slice-of-life yuri romance about a burnt out writer and a fairy who might just help her out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092190/Our_Home_My_Keeper/

Please Be Happy is a comfy slice-of-life yuri romance about a traveling foxgirl and the pair of women she meets one fateful day in Wellington.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844670/Please_Be_Happy/

Twofold is an LGBT+ romance about a struggling nonbinary college student and the women who help them pass—but need help of their own.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1749770/Twofold/

We're also teaming up with several other visual novel developers to share the wide world of visual novels in the festival!

notes.title: New Artwork!
notes.content:
Lock & Key is getting an art upgrade! The main artist, milkgrrl, is redoing some of the artwork to make it more stylized and expressive. Most of these artwork upgrades are finished and we've shown off some of them before on our Patreon and Discord server, so today we're compiling a lot of the new artwork into one post.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/0f231d4c3db391dc17889c2ce2c76b966e3ef0f3.png
For reference, this is what the old character sprite art looks like in the current demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/1e6f5e80676ac876a642670bf54776e1a7d7fb59.png
We also have some casual outfits for the girls!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/344bb1ff69646131179f9f9fa2c556426b489811.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/e213b2306c7a284e408fc4dc451b9f5394de6e65.png
 And we also have some new screenshots with these sprites and an updated GUI!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/20d4788377e9aa12adbe8888f78c41224c63da4f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/a2f45637e8b2ca2733693bbf280bf9e22b5b651b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/87f25d8d6ece8c4947131e56e9246ff39b879365.png
This updated artwork will be available in a new demo coming out in around a month. It'll be the same as the current demo on here on Steam, just with updated visuals, so if you want to see more about the story & characters then go ahead and give it a try!

If you want to see more posts about Lock & Key, we have an entire collection of them on Patreon, including updates and process posts.

We're still planning on a Kickstarter for Lock & Key Kickstarter for the end of the year, which will allow us to offset some of the costs from production as well as give you the chance to get merch such as physical PC copies, keychains, etc. and some exclusives!
